entries.text: Snowflake gateway options now work on snowflake-connector-python 5.x: gateway_ca_bundle is passed to the connector as extra_root_store_path (no REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE needed), gateway_ocsp_fail_open maps to crl_check_mode (true -> ADVISORY, false -> ENABLED), and allow_insecure_gateway maps to crl_check_mode DISABLED, which wins when both are set. Connectors below 5 keep ocsp_fail_open, insecure_mode and the REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE requirement unchanged.
